/** The only production module that chooses and connects concrete integrations. */
export function createBackend(projectRoot: string, diagramsDirectory: string, configuredDomainProfileId: BuiltInDomainProfileId | undefined,
  mappingPocSourceRoot: string, options: { lspEnabled?: boolean; piEnabled?: boolean }) {
  const fake = process.env.NEW_DIAGRAM_AGENT === "fake";
  const chatRuntime = fake ? new FakeLocalChatRuntime() : new CodexLocalChatRuntime(options.piEnabled === true);
  const mappingRuntime = fake ? new FakeMappingAgentRuntime() : new PiMappingAgentRuntime(options.piEnabled === true);
  const store = new DiagramStore(projectRoot, diagramsDirectory);
  const contextSources = new FileAgentContextSources(store.storeRoot, async sourceId => {
    if (sourceId.startsWith('repo-')) {
      return { kind: 'git-worktree', root: await store.repositories.resolveCheckoutRoot(sourceId) };
    }
    const project = await store.loadProject();
    if (!project) throw Error('AGENT_CONTEXT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: project is not initialized');
    return (await resolveDiagramSource(store, { projectId: project.id, sourceId })).binding().corpus;
  });
  const diagramEditRuntime = fake ? new FakeDiagramEditRuntime() : new PiDiagramEditRuntime(mappingPocSourceRoot, options.piEnabled === true, contextSources);
  const core = createCoreApplication(store);
  const compactionService = createFileCompactionService(core, fake ? new FakeFileCompactionRuntime() : new PiFileCompactionRuntime(options.piEnabled === true));
  const languageService = options.lspEnabled === true ? new ProjectLanguageService() : undefined;
  const diagrams = new MappingDiagramService(store, corpusAccess, projectRoot, configuredDomainProfileId, new WorkspaceRecordStore(store.storeRoot));
  const canvasBridge = new GenerationCanvasBridge(new CanvasSessionBridge());
  const contextLibrary = new AgentContextLibrary(new FileAgentContextRepository(store.storeRoot), contextSources);
  const agentContexts = new AgentContextService(undefined, contextLibrary);
  const diagramContextStore = new FileDiagramAgentContextStore(store.storeRoot, contextSources);
  const apiProjection = new CanvasApiProjection();
  const liveCanvas = new LiveCanvasService(() => canvasBridge.list(), async (workspaceInstanceId, documentId) =>
    await canvasBridge.dispatch(workspaceInstanceId, { method: 'context', documentId }) as import('../../../domain/mapping/agent/liveCanvasStatus').LiveCanvasContext, agentContexts, apiProjection);
  const changes = new ChangeSessionService(new DiagramChangeSessionStore(store.storeRoot, undefined, true), store, canvasBridge);
  const agent = new AgentDiagrammingSessionService(canvasBridge, diagrams, store, new QuickJsAgentRuntime(),

import { attachLiveCanvasSockets } from '../routes/mapping/liveCanvasRoutes';
import type { Connect, Plugin, ViteDevServer, PreviewServer } from "vite";
import { ApplicationError } from '../../../application/core/errors';
import type { BuiltInDomainProfileId } from "../../../domain/core/profiles/domainProfile";
import { isBuiltInDomainProfileId } from "../../../domain/core/profiles/domainProfiles";
import { ProjectDiagramConflict } from "../../../domain/core/representations/errors";
import { createBackend } from './bootstrap';

import { RequestTooLarge, sendEvent, sendJson } from "../http/http";

/** Vite adapter: mount HTTP routes and translate transport errors. */
export function diagramApi(
  projectRoot: string,
  diagramsDirectory = ".diagrams",
  configuredDomainProfileId: BuiltInDomainProfileId | undefined = isBuiltInDomainProfileId(
    process.env.NEW_DIAGRAM_DOMAIN
  ) ? process.env.NEW_DIAGRAM_DOMAIN : undefined,
  mappingPocSourceRoot = projectRoot,
  options: { httpEnabled?: boolean; piEnabled?: boolean; lspEnabled?: boolean } = {}
): Plugin {
  const backend = createBackend(projectRoot, diagramsDirectory,
    configuredDomainProfileId, mappingPocSourceRoot, options);
  const middleware: Connect.NextHandleFunction = async (request, response, next) => {
    const url = new URL(request.url ?? "/", "http://localhost");
    if (!["/api", "/internal"].some(prefix => url.pathname === prefix || url.pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`))) {
      next();
      return;
    }
    if (options.httpEnabled !== true && !request.headers['x-canvas-chat-binding'] && isAgentMutationRequest(request.method, url.pathname)) return sendJson(response, 403, {
      code: "HTTP_WRITES_DISABLED", error: "Agent API writes are disabled; start the server with --http to enable them."
    });
    const { routes } = backend;
    const namespace = url.pathname.split("/")[2];
    if (!url.pathname.startsWith("/api/") || !Object.hasOwn(routes, namespace)) {
      return sendJson(response, 404, { error: "API route not found" });
    }
    try {
      await routes[namespace as keyof typeof routes](request, response, url);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "request failed";
      if (response.headersSent) {
        sendEvent(response, { type: "error", error: message });
        if (!response.destroyed && !response.writableEnded) response.end();
      } else {
        const status = error instanceof RequestTooLarge ? 413 : error instanceof ProjectDiagramConflict ? 409 : error instanceof ApplicationError
          ? { conflict: 409, 'invalid-input': 400, 'binary-source': 415, 'lsp-disabled': 503, 'ai-disabled': 503, 'storage-unavailable': 503 }[error.code] : 400;
        sendJson(response, status, { ...(error instanceof ApplicationError && ['lsp-disabled', 'ai-disabled'].includes(error.code) ? { code: error.code === 'ai-disabled' ? 'AI_DISABLED' : 'LSP_DISABLED' } : {}), error: message });
      }
    }
  };
  const attach = (server: ViteDevServer | PreviewServer) => {
    server.middlewares.use(middleware);
    const disposeSockets = server.httpServer
      ? attachLiveCanvasSockets(server.httpServer, backend.liveCanvas, { agentContextUploadsEnabled: options.httpEnabled === true,
        canvasWritesEnabled: options.httpEnabled === true }) : undefined;
    server.httpServer?.once("close", () => {
      disposeSockets?.();
      backend.dispose();
    });
  };
  return { name: "new-diagram-api", configureServer: attach, configurePreviewServer: attach };
}
"},{"path":"src/server/routes/core/routes.ts","text":"import type { ServerResponse } from "node:http";
import type { Connect } from "vite";
import type { CoreApplication } from "../../../../application/core/application";
import type { ProjectCatalogService } from '../../../../application/core/representations/projectCatalogService';
import type { ProjectSourceService } from '../../../../application/core/source/projectSource';
import { type SaveProjectedTreeInput } from "../../../../domain/core/representations/catalogCommands";
import { readBody, sendJson } from "../../http/http";

export function createCoreRoutes({ application, source, catalog }: {
  source: ProjectSourceService;
  catalog: ProjectCatalogService;
  application: CoreApplication;
}) {
  return async (request: Connect.IncomingMessage, response: ServerResponse, url: URL): Promise<void> => {
    if (url.pathname === '/api/core/project/files') {
      if (request.method !== 'GET') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
      return sendJson(response, 200, await source.files(url.searchParams.get('projectId'), url.searchParams.get('path') ?? '', url.searchParams.get('sourceId') ?? undefined));
    }
    if (url.pathname === '/api/core/project/definitions') {
      if (request.method !== 'POST') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
      source.ensureDefinitionsEnabled();
      const body = await readBody(request) as Parameters<ProjectSourceService['definitions']>[0];
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const abort = () => { if (!response.writableEnded) controller.abort(); };
      response.once('close', abort);
      try {
        const result = await source.definitions(body, controller.signal);
        if (!response.destroyed) return sendJson(response, 200, result);
      } finally { response.removeListener('close', abort); }
      return;
    }
    if (url.pathname === '/api/core/project/source') {
      if (request.method !== 'GET') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
      return sendJson(response, 200, await source.source(url.searchParams.get('projectId'), url.searchParams.get('path'), url.searchParams.get('sourceId') ?? undefined));
    }
    if (url.pathname === '/api/core/project/projections') {
      if (request.method !== 'POST') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
      return sendJson(response, 200, await catalog.saveProjection(await readBody(request) as SaveProjectedTreeInput));
    }
    if (url.pathname === "/api/core/project/corpus-compactions") {
      await catalog.requireProject();
      if (request.method === "GET") return sendJson(response, 200, await catalog.compactions());
      if (request.method !== "POST") return sendJson(response, 405, { error: "method not allowed" });
      const body = await readBody(request);
      return sendJson(response, 201, await application.upsertProjectFileCompaction(
        body as import("../../../../domain/core/representations/projectCatalog").ProjectFileCompactionInput
      ));
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/api/core/project/representations") {
      if (request.method !== "GET") return sendJson(response, 405, { error: "method not allowed" });
      return sendJson(response, 200, await application.projectRepresentations(url.searchParams.get('history') === 'current' ? 'current' : 'all'));
    }

    return sendJson(response, 404, { error: "API route not found" });
  };
}

export function createMappingRoutes({ selection, diagrams, workspace, chat, compactionService, agent, agentChat, liveCanvas, diffSessionWorkflows, pushIntegrations, pushToken, compareSessions, comparisonRuns, evalRuns, evalPrompts, evalReferences }: {
  evalRuns?: EvalRunService; evalPrompts?: EvalPromptService; evalReferences?: EvalReferenceService;

  chat: LocalChatService; compactionService: FileCompactionService;
}) {
  return async (request: Connect.IncomingMessage, response: ServerResponse, url: URL): Promise<void> => {
    if ((url.pathname === '/api/mapping/generated-canvases' || url.pathname.startsWith('/api/mapping/generated-canvases/')) && evalRuns)
      return handleGeneratedCanvasRoutes(request, response, url, evalRuns);
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/mapping/evals/') && evalRuns && evalPrompts && evalReferences) return handleEvalRoutes(request, response, url, evalPrompts, evalRuns, evalReferences);
    if ((url.pathname === '/api/mapping/comparison-runs' || url.pathname.startsWith('/api/mapping/comparison-runs/')) && comparisonRuns)
      return handleComparisonGenerationRoutes(request, response, url, comparisonRuns);
    if ((url.pathname === '/api/mapping/compare-sessions' || url.pathname.startsWith('/api/mapping/compare-sessions/')) && compareSessions)
      return handleCompareRoutes(request, response, url, compareSessions);
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/mapping/agent-chat/') && agentChat) return handleAgentChat(request, response, url, agentChat);
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/mapping/integrations/') && pushIntegrations)
      return handlePushIntegration(request, response, url, pushIntegrations, pushToken);
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/mapping/workflows/diff-session-create') && diffSessionWorkflows)
      return handleDiffSessionWorkflow(request, response, url, diffSessionWorkflows);
    if (url.pathname === '/api/mapping/live/context/short' && liveCanvas) return readShortContext(request, response, url, liveCanvas);
    const selectionRead = url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/mapping\/live\/connections\/([^/]+)\/selection$/);
    if (selectionRead && liveCanvas) return readLiveSelection(request, response, decodeURIComponent(selectionRead[1]), liveCanvas);
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/mapping/agent/') && agent) return handleAgentRoutes(request, response, url, agent);
    if (url.pathname === '/api/mapping/compactions' || url.pathname.startsWith('/api/mapping/compactions/')) {
      return handleFileCompaction(request, response, url, compactionService);
    }
    if (url.pathname === '/api/mapping/workspace/records') {
      if (request.method === 'GET') return sendJson(response, 200, await workspace.loadRecords(url.searchParams.get('history') === 'current' ? 'current' : 'all'));
      if (request.method === 'POST') return sendJson(response, 200, await workspace.applyBatch(await readBody(request, 64 * 1024 * 1024) as WorkspaceBatch));
      return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
    }
    if (url.pathname === '/api/mapping/workspace/export') {
      if (request.method !== 'POST') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
      return sendJson(response, 200, await workspace.portableExport(await readBody(request, 64 * 1024 * 1024)));
    }
    if (url.pathname === '/api/mapping/workspace/import-contexts') {
      if (request.method !== 'POST') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
      return sendJson(response, 200, await workspace.prepareImport(await readBody(request, 64 * 1024 * 1024)));
    }
    if (url.pathname === '/api/mapping/workspace') {
      if (request.method === 'GET') return sendJson(response, 200, await workspace.load());
      if (request.method !== 'PUT') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
      // Workspace saves include revision histories and captured source evidence.
      return sendJson(response, 200, await workspace.save(await readBody(request, 64 * 1024 * 1024)));
    }
    if (url.pathname === '/api/mapping/chat') return handleLocalChat(request, response, chat);
    if (url.pathname === '/api/mapping/diagrams/publish' && request.method === 'POST')
      return sendJson(response, 200, await diagrams.publishCheckpoint(await readBody(request) as import('../../../../domain/core/diagrams/checkpointPublication').CheckpointPublication));
    if (url.pathname === '/api/mapping/diagrams') {
      if (request.method !== 'POST') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
      return sendJson(response, 200, await diagrams.save(await readBody(request) as SaveProjectDiagramInput));
    }
    const diagram = url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/mapping\/diagrams\/([^/]+)$/);
    if (diagram) {
      if (request.method !== 'DELETE') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
      return sendJson(response, 200, await diagrams.delete(decodeURIComponent(diagram[1])));
    }
    if (url.pathname === '/api/mapping/prompt') {
      if (request.method !== 'POST') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
      const input = await selection.prepare(await readBody(request) as Record<string, unknown>);
      response.statusCode = 200;
      response.setHeader('content-type', 'application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8');

      const result = await selection.run(input, event => sendEvent(response, { type: 'progress', ...event }));
      sendEvent(response, { type: 'result', result });
      response.end();
      return;
    }
    return sendJson(response, 404, { error: 'API route not found' });
  };
}

import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import ts from "typescript";
import { sourceClassification } from "../../domain/core/static-analysis/classification";
import { expect, it } from "vitest";

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../..", import.meta.url));
const config = ts.readConfigFile(path.join(root, "tsconfig.json"), ts.sys.readFile);
const { options } = ts.parseJsonConfigFileContent(config.config, ts.sys, root);
const resolutionCache = ts.createModuleResolutionCache(root, (file) => file, options);

function files(directory: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
    const file = path.join(directory, entry.name);
    return entry.isDirectory() ? files(file) : /\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(file) ? [file] : [];
  });
}

function location(file: string) {
  return sourceClassification(path.relative(root, file).split(path.sep).join('/'));
}

it("preserves feature ownership and HTTP/application/infrastructure/domain boundaries", () => {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const runtime of ["src", "application", "infrastructure", "domain"]) {
    for (const file of files(path.join(root, runtime))) {
      // Integration tests may exercise the composition root.
      if (/\.test\.tsx?$/.test(file)) continue;
      const from = location(file);
      const source = ts.createSourceFile(file, readFileSync(file, "utf8"), ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true);
      function visit(node: ts.Node) {
        let specifier: ts.Node | undefined;
        if (ts.isImportDeclaration(node) || ts.isExportDeclaration(node)) specifier = node.moduleSpecifier;
        if (ts.isImportTypeNode(node) && ts.isLiteralTypeNode(node.argument)) specifier = node.argument.literal;
        if (ts.isCallExpression(node) && (node.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword
          || ts.isIdentifier(node.expression) && node.expression.text === "require")) specifier = node.arguments[0];
        if (specifier && ts.isStringLiteral(specifier)) {
          const name = specifier.text;
          const aliasedImport = Object.keys(options.paths ?? {}).some((pattern) => {
            const [prefix, suffix] = pattern.split("*");
            return suffix === undefined ? name === prefix : name.startsWith(prefix) && name.endsWith(suffix);
          });
          // Relative imports already identify the owning directory. Resolve only
          // aliases through TypeScript to avoid filesystem probing for every edge.
          const resolved = aliasedImport
            ? ts.resolveModuleName(name, file, options, ts.sys, resolutionCache).resolvedModule
            : undefined;
          const target = name.startsWith(".") ? path.resolve(path.dirname(file), name)
            : resolved && !resolved.isExternalLibraryImport ? resolved.resolvedFileName : undefined;
          const externalRuntime = /^(?:node:|react(?:-dom)?(?:\/|$)|vite(?:\/|$))/.test(name);
          let invalid = from.runtime === "domain" && externalRuntime
            || from.runtime === "src" && name.startsWith("node:")
            || from.runtime === "application" && /^(?:node:(?:fs|child_process|http|https|net)(?:\/|$)|vite(?:\/|$)|react(?:-dom)?(?:\/|$)|@earendil-works\/|vscode-jsonrpc)/.test(name);
          if (target) {
            const to = location(target);
            const allowedLayers: Record<string, string[]> = {
              domain: ["domain"], src: ["src", "domain", "packages"],
              application: ["application", "domain"],
              infrastructure: ["infrastructure", "application", "domain"],
              server: from.bootstrap ? ["server", "application", "infrastructure", "domain"] : ["server", "application", "domain"]
            };
            const runtimeAllowed = allowedLayers[from.runtime]?.includes(to.runtime) ?? false;
            const ownershipAllowed = from.composition || !to.composition && (to.owner === "core" || to.owner === from.owner);
            invalid ||= !runtimeAllowed || !ownershipAllowed;
          }
          if (invalid) violations.push(`${path.relative(root, file)} imports ${name}`);
        }
        ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
      }
      visit(source);
    }
  }
  expect(violations).toEqual([]);
});

it('keeps diagram construction and prepared content edits inside the Diagram domain model', () => {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const runtime of ['domain', 'application', 'infrastructure', 'src']) for (const file of files(path.join(root, runtime))) {
    if (file.includes('/__tests__/')) continue;
    const relative = path.relative(root, file).replaceAll(path.sep, '/');
    const source = ts.createSourceFile(file, readFileSync(file, 'utf8'), ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true);
    const walk = (node: ts.Node) => {
      if (ts.isCallExpression(node)) {
        const name = ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(node.expression) ? node.expression.name.text : node.expression.getText(source);
        if (name === 'constructDiagram' && !['domain/core/diagrams/diagramRevisionEditor.ts', 'domain/core/diagrams/submitDiagramEdit.ts'].includes(relative)
          || ['prepareCreate', 'prepareEdit'].includes(name) && relative !== 'domain/core/diagrams/diagramRevision.ts')
          violations.push(`${relative}: ${name}`);
      }
      ts.forEachChild(node, walk);
    };
    walk(source);
  }
  expect(violations).toEqual([]);
});

{"ascii":"Application Composition and Transports
|-- Construct the service graph: createBackend() [src/server/app/bootstrap.ts]
|   |-- Select concrete integrations, then inject them into application services
|   |   |-- NEW_DIAGRAM_AGENT=fake substitutes local-chat, mapping, edit, compaction,
|   |   |   eval and comparison runtimes
|   |   |   `-- AgentChat still receives StdioCodexConnection; diff workflows receive PiDiffSessionRuntime
|   |   |-- piEnabled is passed to real AI integrations and workflow enablement
|   |   `-- lspEnabled selects whether ProjectSourceService receives ProjectLanguageService
|   |-- Share persistence and source access [handoff: persistence]
|   |   |-- One DiagramStore supplies core, diagram, workspace, agent and evaluation services
|   |   |   `-- Its storeRoot anchors the separate filesystem repositories injected into services
|   |   `-- corpusAccess supplies provider, line reads and discovery to core/source/diagram services
|   |-- Share live-canvas access [handoff: agent_access]
|   |   |-- One GenerationCanvasBridge wraps CanvasSessionBridge
|   |   |   |-- LiveCanvasService consumes list() and dispatch(context)
|   |   |   `-- ChangeSessionService, AgentDiagrammingSessionService and AgentChatService receive it
|   |   |-- LiveCanvasService and AgentDiagrammingSessionService share CanvasApiProjection
|   |   `-- AgentContextLibrary supplies AgentContextService, AgentChatService and EvalRunService
|   |-- Connect conversations and workflows to the same application services
|   |   |-- AgentChatService receives LiveCanvasService and tools bound to the agent service [chat]
|   |   |-- LocalChatService separately receives store, corpus access and its selected runtime
|   |   `-- PushIntegrationService receives DiffSessionWorkflowService
|   |       `-- DiffSessionWorkflowService receives the existing change and agent services
|   |-- Connect generation and assessment [handoff: evals]
|   |   |-- CompareSessionService and EvalRunService share workspace and GeneratedCanvasCatalog
|   |   |-- AgentChat generation observations -> EvalRunService.recordLegacy()
|   |   |   `-- Legacy replay/cancel callbacks invoke AgentChatService
|   |   |-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog.snapshot -> EvalRunService.outputSnapshot()
|   |   `-- EvalRunService receives reference generation, comparison-backed judgements and experiments
|   `-- Return routes, liveCanvas, diffSessionWorkflows, pushIntegrations and dispose()
|       `-- Route factories receive these constructed services; requests invoke the shared graph
|-- Mount the graph: diagramApi() [src/server/app/vitePlugin.ts]
|   |-- Construct one backend per plugin instance
|   |   `-- Development and preview hooks use the same attach(server) function
|   |-- HTTP middleware -> namespace route -> injected application service
|   |   |-- Outside /api and /internal -> next middleware; unknown API namespace -> 404
|   |   |-- /api/core -> source, catalog and core application [src/server/routes/core/routes.ts]
|   |   `-- /api/mapping -> mapping services [src/server/routes/mapping/routes.ts]
|   |       |-- Optional route families delegate only when their required services are supplied
|   |       |-- POST workspace/records -> MappingWorkspaceService.applyBatch() [workspace]
|   |       |-- POST diagrams/publish -> MappingDiagramService.publishCheckpoint() [persistence]
|   |       |   `-- Return the awaited service result; storage visibility semantics belong downstream
|   |       `-- POST prompt -> SelectionService.prepare(), then run(); stream progress and result
|   |-- Attach live-canvas sockets when an HTTP server exists
|   |   `-- Socket attachment receives the same backend.liveCanvas used by HTTP routes
|   |-- Access options are transport-specific
|   |   |-- HTTP: requests classified as agent mutations are rejected when httpEnabled is false
|   |   |   `-- Presence of x-canvas-chat-binding bypasses this particular rejection check
|   |   `-- Sockets: context uploads and canvas writes enabled only when httpEnabled is true
|   |-- Translate caught route errors into JSON status responses
|   |   `-- If headers were already sent, emit an error event and end an open response
|   `-- HTTP server close -> invoke socket cleanup, then backend.dispose()
|       |-- Backend invokes disposal on composed services, agent runtimes, bridge and optional LSP
|       `-- Calls are not awaited here; this boundary does not establish completed persistence
|-- Compose browser dependencies [src/app/App.tsx + src/app/services.ts]
|   |-- App retains a createMappingServices() bundle through useState
|   |   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService('current') + WorkspaceStorage
|   |   `-- HTTP diagram generator + HTTP code-repository service
|   `-- Path selects the page receiving that bundle
|       |-- BASE_URL + evals, after trailing-slash normalization -> lazy EvalsPage inside Suspense
|       `-- Other paths, including unknown legacy entries -> MappingPocPage
`-- Declare dependency policy [tests/architecture/dependencies.test.ts]
    |-- Allowed internal imports; arrows below mean permission to depend on
    |   |-- domain -> domain
    |   |-- application -> application, domain
    |   |-- infrastructure -> infrastructure, application, domain
    |   |-- server -> server, application, domain
    |   |   `-- Bootstrap-classified server code may additionally import infrastructure
    |   `-- UI/src -> src, domain, packages
    |-- Ownership rules apply alongside layer rules
    |   |-- Composition code may cross feature ownership boundaries within permitted layers
    |   `-- Other code may depend on core or its own owner, excluding composition code
    |-- Runtime restrictions keep Node/React/Vite out of domain and Node out of UI
    |   `-- Application additionally rejects listed Node I/O, UI and agent-integration dependencies
    |-- Diagram construction and prepared edits are restricted to designated domain files [diagrams]
    `-- Tests collect violations and expect none; the pinned files contain policy, not a test-run result"}
